artifacts.parse_error: x509: RSA key missing NULL parameters

findings.title: Certificate could not be parsed
findings.explanation: This block is framed as a certificate, but the X.509 parser rejected it. Its fingerprints are computed from the bytes where possible; none of its other fields are shown, because none can be relied on.

evidence.value: x509: RSA key missing NULL parameters

remediation.text: Obtain a correctly encoded certificate from its issuer.

findings.title: Public key has a non-canonical encoding
findings.explanation: The public key is encoded differently from its canonical form, for example RSA without NULL parameters or a compressed EC point. Its x509-spki-sha256 identity uses the canonical form, so the as-encoded fingerprint differs and is shown separately. Some software rejects such encodings.

remediation.text: Reissue the certificate with a canonically encoded public key.
